title: Aromatic Jamaican Chestnut Mushroom Skewers
description: Floral and fluffy, these festive Jamaican skewers feature chestnut mushrooms and a char-grill yang flavor, all on a hot stone plate, vegan-friendly.
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, puree scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, allspice, garlic, lime juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pepper puree and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the marinade and toss to coat, letting them marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking, then grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Once the mushrooms are tender and slightly charred, remove them from the grill and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the skewers on a hot stone plate, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
